fields.statement: At f95af36fd ran `go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run SessionRunRexRetry`: TestSessionRunRexRetryRecovers (fake rex: a failed call, then output with no window_id, then a window) passes with 3 rex calls, a single successful tab open and two growing injected waits; TestSessionRunRexRetryGivesUp (four failures) passes with exit 1, 4 calls, 3 waits and a message holding Rex's last error 'rex is down'.
